subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped update land only after direct Codex source review and completed exact-head checks, or should the Codex action bump be split out first?
rationale: The PR changes executable third-party code in credential-bearing and release/security workflows, and OpenClaw policy imposes a direct-source gate specifically on Codex-related changes.

options.title: Split the Codex bump
options.body: Remove the openai/codex-action changes from this group, land the remaining verified same-major action pins after exact-head CI, and review Codex separately.

options.title: Approve the grouped update
options.body: Keep all 14 updates together only after direct sibling Codex source inspection and targeted verification of the secret-gated, release, and scanning workflows.

options.title: Pause for a refreshed bot head
options.body: Wait for Dependabot to regain access, rebase onto current main, and produce a stable exact-head check result before reviewing again.

recommendation.title: Split the Codex bump
recommendation.body: Remove the openai/codex-action changes from this group, land the remaining verified same-major action pins after exact-head CI, and review Codex separately.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline explicitly routed this security-sensitive workflow update to steipete, the best available human decision signal.
